Can you explain the main options in simple terms?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Here’s a simple starting point:
Whiskey — rich and warming; often tastes of vanilla, caramel, spice, oak, or smoke. Main styles include Bourbon, Rye, and Scotch.
Tequila — made in styles from bright, unaged Blanco/Silver to lightly barrel-aged Reposado; great neat or in cocktails.
Rum — made from sugarcane or molasses; can be light and tropical, or darker, richer, and spicier.
Gin — crisp and botanical, usually led by juniper; ideal if you enjoy fresh, herbal, citrusy drinks.
Vodka — clear and neutral in style, making it an easy base for mixed drinks.
Brandy — fruit-based and often smooth, warming, and mellow.
Flaviar carries all of these categories, from familiar classics to smaller-batch bottles.
